obligations.label: a covered transaction is not a qualified mortgage when its total points and fees, as defined in 1026.32(b)(1), exceed the applicable tier limit
tier A limit: 3 percent of the total loan amount when the loan amount is at or above the adjusted 100,000 dollar figure
tier B limit: the adjusted 3,000 dollar figure when the loan amount is between the adjusted 60,000 and 100,000 dollar figures
tier C limit: 5 percent of the total loan amount when the loan amount is between the adjusted 20,000 and 60,000 dollar figures
tier D limit: the adjusted 1,000 dollar figure when the loan amount is between the adjusted 12,500 and 20,000 dollar figures
tier E limit: 8 percent of the total loan amount when the loan amount is below the adjusted 12,500 dollar figure
the dollar figures and loan-amount bands are adjusted each January 1 by the CPI-U change reported the preceding June 1, per the official commentary
